metodo: DirectorIA (repositorio Society): JSON Decoded Brief de la FOTO, campo a campo, en inglés; la maqueta va aparte

medicion.nota: Protocolo de directoria/hosteleria/02 §7-§8, sobre la versión sin texto, a 180 × 240

foto.subject_identity: A heaped salad of tomato wedges, yellow and orange pepper strips, thin red onion rings and two whole basil leaves on top, in a shallow round stoneware bowl about 20 cm across with a black reactive glaze speckled blue-grey
foto.realism: Real editorial food photograph in natural light, not a render
foto.environment: The bowl sits on a worn dark oak board with visible grain, fine knife marks and scratches. A chef's knife with a worn wooden handle lies diagonally in the bottom-right corner, cut off by the frame. About 1.5 m behind, a plain matt slate-blue painted wall; a slightly darker horizontal band at the height of the bowl rim marks the far edge of the table
foto.lighting: One large soft window light from behind and to the left of the bowl (about 10 o'clock, 45 degrees behind): bright highlights on the tops of the basil leaves and on the left rim of the bowl, a soft sheen on the board behind the bowl, the right side of the bowl falling into shadow. No fill from the front. The wall receives only the spill: brighter behind the bowl, darker towards the edges

camera.visible_result: The whole bowl and the salad sharp, the knife handle slightly soft, the wall a smooth out-of-focus gradient

foto.composition: Vertical 4:5. Camera about 20 degrees above the table (the rim of the bowl reads as a flat ellipse, about one third as tall as it is wide). The bowl centred, slightly left, in the lower 55% of the frame; the top of the basil at about 40% from the top. The upper 40% is empty wall for the headline. The knife enters from the bottom-right corner at about 20 degrees and points at the bowl
foto.imperfections: Irregular onion rings, a torn edge on one tomato wedge, a fleck of herb on the bowl rim, knife scratches on the board to the left of the bowl, uneven glaze speckles
foto.palette: Vivid food colours (tomato red, pepper yellow-orange, basil green, magenta onion) against a cool, desaturated slate-blue wall and a warm brown board

queSeToma: La cámara baja: unos 20° sobre la mesa, 90 mm, f/4. Es lo contrario del ¾ alto de la foto del hostelero
El plato en la mitad baja y el 40 % superior libre para el titular
La luz: una sola fuente grande y suave detrás a la izquierda, que recorta los bordes, y el lado derecho en sombra
El fondo que se lee: pared pizarra a unos 1,5 m (luminancia ≈ 36), no un vacío negro
La superficie de madera oscura gastada (el mantel y el fondo son libres, decisión del 07/11)
La diagonal del cuchillo, pero la hacen las antenas de la gamba: no se añade ningún objeto
queNoSeCopia: El cuenco, la ensalada y el cuchillo
Los textos, la tipografía y el filete (los pone el compositor, aparte)
Cualquier dato del local de la referencia
porQueFallabaNuestraVersion: La ficha guardaba la foto en una línea («Low-key con luz lateral, plato con aire arriba»)
El prompt pedía «seamless flat charcoal backdrop #111111»: un vacío. La referencia tiene pared, mesa y profundidad
Medido: fondo 7 frente a 36 y saturación 0,22 frente a 0,43 (b3 frente a post-11)
La cámara pedida (¾ a 25°) quedaba cerca de la foto original (¾ a 45°) y el modelo volvió a ella
